name: Trump of the Oliphaunt

stealth.note: (master) to notice the tension of a low vibration forming in the area from the imminent release of the Oliphaunt's trumpet

description: An overwhelming trumpeting sound vibrates and suffuses the area, causing everything to slow.
disable: DC 38 Arcana (expert), maelstrom-lore|dc:38|name:Shore Up the Area (expert), DC 38 Occultism (master), DC 38 Religion (master) to recognize and shore up the area against the localized planar instability causing a connection to the Oliphaunt of Jandelay. Four successes are needed to strengthen the area enough against the instability to end the hazard.
reset: The area becomes unstable again after 24 hours.
routine:
(1 action) Each creature in the area must attempt a DC 36 Fortitude Saving Throw save. A creature with the slowed condition from this hazard takes a –2 circumstance penalty on further saves against this effect.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes (2d6+6) Sonic Damage damage and is Deafened for 1 round.

Failure The creature takes (4d6+13) Sonic Damage damage and is Slowed 1 for 2 rounds.

Critical Failure The creature takes (8d6+26) Sonic Damage damage and is Slowed 2 for 2 rounds.

generalAbilities.name: Bone-Shattering Rhythms
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger Three or more characters enter the area of planar instability

Effect Pent-up magical energy from another world begins to release in waves of overwhelming sound. The hazard rolls initiative.
